disposals--antero-pioneer.s: From New Martinsville, take WV-2 South and turn left onto WV-180 South. At the stop-sign T, turn left onto WV-18 South. Go through Middlebourne, turn right onto the bridge/Bridgeway Road, then turn left onto Wick Road. Follow Wick Road to Pioneer on the right at the top of the hill. Spotters will assign a lane. Follow the site SOP, including whip checks, hose and truck grounding, bucket, duck ponds, and face shield.
